title: The workbook's formulas can't be recalculated with LibreOffice, the only spreadsheet engine in the environment, so the required 'refresh outputs' step can't be done cleanly
evidence: The MA, bias and signal formulas use OFFSET with a negative height. One example is Timing_Strategy!E14 '=AVERAGE(OFFSET(D14,0,0,MAX(13-ROW(B14),-$B$9),1))', and D12 and H11 work the same way. Excel accepts a negative height; LibreOffice does not. I rendered the seed file 148_src_0.xlsx with the container's soffice. Every cell in the MA column and the Bias Ratio column showed 'Err:502' (see pg-001.png), and the error carries on into the Method 1 signal, the positions and the return tables. The GT gt_148_ref_0.xlsx holds valid cached numbers that were plainly recalculated in Excel: 38,442 cached values change on Timing_Strategy and 77,387 on Timing_Strategy_Return, for example Timing_Strategy_Return!B3 0.2284 -> 0.2192 and O4 'Dividend' -> 'Growth'. The grader guidance asks whether the output values are 'logically equivalent to the reference answer'. An agent therefore has three options, each with a cost: (a) recalculate in LibreOffice and deliver Err:502 everywhere; (b) edit the 3 inputs with openpyxl and leave stale cached outputs, which ignores 'ensure the model outputs are refreshed'; or (c) rewrite the model's formulas, which counts as an over-edit. None of these is a clean pass with the tools provided.
confirmation: Verified: E14 '=AVERAGE(OFFSET(D14,0,0,MAX(13-ROW(B14),-$B$9),1))' uses a negative OFFSET height that LibreOffice rejects (#VALUE! after soffice conversion), so the required 'refresh outputs' step cannot be done with the only available engine while the GT holds Excel-recalculated values.
fix: Rewrote the Excel-only negative-height OFFSET formulas into equivalent positive-height ones, in both 148_src_0.xlsx (data) and gt_148_ref_0.xlsx (GT), editing only formula text in the sheet XML and keeping every cached value and style. Timing_Strategy D12 and E14:E5075 (MA): OFFSET(D14,0,0,MAX(13-ROW(B14),-$B$9),1) -> OFFSET(D14,MAX(13-ROW(B14),-$B$9)+1,0,-MAX(13-ROW(B14),-$B$9),1). Benchmark Return and Timing_Strategy_Return B6:P5223 (drawdown): OFFSET($A6,0,0,B$2-ROW()+6,1) -> OFFSET($A6,IF(B$2-ROW()+6<0,B$2-ROW()+7,0),0,ABS(B$2-ROW()+6),1). Checked: a LibreOffice recalculation (verifier pipeline) of each patched file now reproduces every Excel-cached value in all four sheets (0 numeric differences, was 60,814 #VALUE! cells on Timing_Strategy alone). The only remaining differences are 17 cells per return sheet that are errors in Excel too (#REF! vs LibreOffice's error code).
